summary: ChowChow Cloud International Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing closing of a previously disclosed private placement. Under the June 16, 2026 securities purchase agreement, the company sold 862,069 ordinary shares at $0.58 for $500,000 aggregate; post a 1-for-10 reverse split effective October 23, 2026, terms adjusted to 86,207 restricted Class A Ordinary Shares at $5.80. The balance was received October 26 and the deal closed October 29, 2026, with shares issued to one investor. This is a routine ordinary equity placement, not a special situation; watch dilution and resale restrictions.
